status.rejected: {count, plural, one {# operation rejected} other {# operations rejected}}

pairing.title: Pair device
pairing.description: Enter the pairing code from the backoffice (Devices → Pairing code). The device needs internet access once for this.
pairing.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired.
pairing.failed: Pairing failed. Check the connection and try again.
pairing.hubCode: This code belongs to the location hub. It is entered on the hub itself, not here.
pairing.pendingElsewhere: This device still has {count, plural, one {# operation} other {# operations}} of its previous location that are not in the cloud yet. Pair it with that location again so nothing is lost.

pin.title: Enter PIN
pin.entered: {count, plural, one {# digit entered} other {# digits entered}}
pin.wrong: Wrong PIN. {attemptsLeft, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left.
pin.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Locked for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
pin.noCredentials: This device has no access data yet. Connect it to the internet once.
pin.notAllowedKitchen: {name} has no kitchen permission. Unlock the kitchen display with the PIN of someone from the kitchen.
pin.failed: That did not work. Enter the PIN again or reload the page.

approval.title: Manager approval
approval.aboveThreshold: This action is above the location’s threshold. A manager approves it with their PIN.
approval.missingPermission: You don’t have permission for this action. A manager approves it with their PIN.
approval.refused: Wrong PIN, or no permission for this action.

shell.updateAvailable: A new version of the POS is ready.
shell.drawerFailed: The drawer could not be opened.
shell.readyTables: {count, plural, one {# table has} other {# tables have}} something ready to serve
shell.readyOrders: {count, plural, one {# order has} other {# orders have}} something ready to hand over

kitchen.readyTable: Table {table}: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} ready
kitchen.readyOrder: Order {number}: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} ready

revoked.title: Device unpaired
revoked.description: “{name}” was deactivated or unpaired in the backoffice. To use it again, enter a new pairing code (Backoffice → Devices).
revoked.pending: {count, plural, one {# operation is} other {# operations are}} not in the cloud yet. They are sent as soon as the device is paired again.
